comments.starlight-katex: Use starlight-katex, NOT raw remark-math + rehype-katex. There are known Starlight CSS conflicts with KaTeX SVG output — see https://github.com/withastro/starlight/issues/2511
comments.starlight-version: Starlight 0.38 is the first version compatible with Astro 6. Do not pair Starlight 0.37 or earlier with Astro 6.
comments.pagefind: Pagefind is built into Starlight by default. Do not add astro-pagefind here.
